description.narrative: Indicator 1.3: number and % of target groups, CSOs/ CBOs, and local government report to have increased knowledge of climate change impacts, associated policy frameworks and issues faced by target groups.

comment.narrative: 40 of people reported to have heard the terminology climate change through radio and newspaper. They had been experiencing its impact but they lack knowledge that the impacts they were experiencing were because of climate change. Hence they didnt have knowledge of climate associated policy frameworks.The baseline conducted previously was not aligned with the revised indicators and project activities. Therefore re assessment of the revised indicators was conducted during Oct2022 and the indicators values are kept as per recent study. The value is based on the original baseline report. There is no change made in the revised logframe.

Reached out to 575 individuals and 100 of target groups reported increased knowledge of climate change impacts associated policy frameworks and issues faced by the target group against the target of 80 based on the endline evaluation survey carried out by third party.

Project beneficiaries tracking sheet and Final evaluation report conducted by third partyIndicator 1.3 80 of target groups CSOs CBOs and local government report to have increased knowledge of climate change impacts associated policy frameworks and issues faced by target groups.
